description: Look up what an NCUA call report account code means, or find the code for a figure. The 5300 Call Report stores everything against codes like ACCT_010 or ACCT_083, and this returns the official name and NCUA's full reporting instruction for each. Answers "what is ACCT_010", "which account code is total assets", "what does NCUA count as a delinquent loan". Searches names and the instruction text. Example: ncua_account_lookup({ code: "ACCT_010" }); ncua_account_lookup({ query: "delinquent loans" }). Keyless.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "total assets", "net worth"

name: ncua_account_lookup
title: Ncua Account Lookup
